branch.description: The branch name should be url-encoded.
branch.name: branch

filter.description:
Restricts which builds are returned.
Set to "completed", "successful", "failed", "running", or defaults to no filter.
filter.name: filter

limit.description: The number of builds to return. Maximum 100, defaults to 30.
limit.name: limit

offset.description: The API returns builds starting from this offset, defaults to 0.
offset.name: offset

dont_build.description: reason why we didn't build, if we didn't build

retry_of.description: build_num of the build this is a retry of

why.description: short string explaining the reason we built

BuildParameters.description: Additional environment variables to inject into the build environment. A map of names to values.

Parallel.description: The number of containers to use to run the build. Default is null and the project default is used.

Revision.description:
The specific revision to build.
Default is null and the head of the branch is used. Cannot be used with tag parameter.

Tag.description: The tag to build. Default is null. Cannot be used with revision parameter.

info.description:
The CircleCI API is a RESTful, fully-featured API that allows you to do almost anything in CircleCI.
You can access all information and trigger all actions.
The only thing we don’t provide access to is billing functions, which must be done from the CircleCI web UI.
info.title: CircleCI REST API
